messages:
Emily Carter: Quick heads-up :wave: — we have a surge of onboarding requests for next weekend. Can we pull together a couple of short enablement clinics (90min) and a fallback plan if demand spikes? Need: facilitator assignments, short agendas, calendar invites, and feedback capture.
Javier Ortiz: I can take Saturday 09:00–10:30 PT (that covers NA morning / EMEA late afternoon). Happy to do live demo + Q&A.
Priya Nair: Sunday 16:00–17:30 CET works for me. Prefer hands-on labs and a quick checklist walkthrough.
Mark Liu: +1 on two sessions. Suggest standard agenda template so CS leads can reuse. Quick draft: 1) 15m onboarding checklist 2) 30m live demo 3) 30m guided lab + triage rooms 4) 15m feedback/next steps.
Emily Carter: Nice. I put together a compact agenda below — please call out edits. Also added a short feedback form link placeholder.
Emily Carter: ```
Agenda (90m):
- 00:00–00:10 | Welcome + customer intro
- 00:10–00:25 | Onboarding health & migration checklist (owner: CS)
- 00:25–00:55 | Live demo: model pinning, routing policies, cost controls (owner: Eng Solutions)
- 00:55–01:25 | Guided lab: connect account, run sample inference, inspect Console metrics
- 01:25–01:30 | Feedback + next steps (capture via short form)
``` 
Priya Nair: Can we ensure labs include a snippet for prefix caching config? Many customers ask about cost reductions.
Javier Ortiz: Also add a tiny blurb on Dedicated vs Private for customers asking about isolation. Two slides max.
Mark Liu: I'll create two calendar events (Sat/Sun) with Zoom links and breakout rooms. Suggest we attach this CSV of accounts to invite so facilitators can pre-read.
Mark Liu: ```
accounts,owner,notes
acme-corp,Jordan,large seq lengths
lumen-health,Sana,PII considerations
novusbio,Alex,needs VPC

i'll attach to invites
``` 
Emily Carter: @ops-bot can you ensure weekend-burst capacity is enabled for Sat/Sun so labs don't hit throttle? Also, can we pin a Dedicated pool for demo traffic?
ops-bot: auto: weekend-burst pool enabled for 2026-05-09/2026-05-10. Reminder: update RBAC for external guests if using shared consoles.
Javier Ortiz: I'll take owner of the Dedicated vs Private slide. Priya — can you own the guided lab notebook + caching snippet?
Priya Nair: Yep, I'll drop the notebook link in the thread tomorrow and share a short runbook for facilitators.
Emily Carter: Cool. One more: we need a lightweight feedback capture — 3 questions max. Who wants to own the form? I can draft.
Mark Liu: I can wire the form to a spreadsheet and create a summary tab for CS manager review.
Emily Carter: Awesome. Plan: Emily will send invites by EOD tomorrow, Mark creates invites + spreadsheet, Priya shares lab notebook, Javier shares slide blurb. Emily will also post the feedback form link in the invites.
Priya Nair: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
Javier Ortiz: Thanks — will prep slides and share by EOD as well.
Emily Carter: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the calendar invites and attendee pre-read. If anything changes ping this thread. :sparkles:
